review_notes: Variant WLC.PSA.102.23.v001 selected r00-base (covers s005-s006); the printed ASV 'my strength' matches the base reading, so no excluded-fallback case arises.

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV main text reads 'He weakened my strength' — the first-person suffix 'my strength' renders the qere כֹּחִי. The textual_variant note 'Another reading is, afflicted me with his strength' names the ketiv כחו ('his strength') as the alternative reading, confirming the ASV text follows the qere and relegates the ketiv to the margin.
